newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mainly stronger.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mainly stronger.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to stronger on Tuesday.
Gasoline barges were flat. Prompt barrels may be attracted over to north American markets again.
Naphtha rose. Apart from a Skikda cargo and a few small Russian pieces, few obvious offers were seen.
Gas oil rose on strong futures and steady premiums as concerns over the arrival of north American material receded.
High sulphur barges gained up to $3, trading as high as $111 fob ARA. The hike was a correction after prices were knocked lower on Monday. "It was oversold," said one trader.
